audit.recode_to: lexical (primary stress lexically on the stem-final or stem-penultimate syllable, some stems unaccented; secondary predictable: word-initial plus alternating toward/after the primary; domain = stem for primary, word for secondary). Cite Dubert & Dubert 1973:30-31 (sec. 4.3) as the deciding quote, OPD 1992/2004 p.3 as confirmation, and note Gordon 2002 appendix 'Even/odd numbered (lexical) from R & initial'; drop the StressTyp2 fixed-penult template as the basis.

audit.reasoning: (1) Quote check: the record carries no deciding quote (quote/cite/loc empty; coding is a StressTyp2/Gordon inheritance). The database passage in 'dq' is confirmed verbatim in the held primary source at Dubert & Dubert 1973 sec. 4.3 p.30 (I rendered PDF pp.26-27 of the full SIL scan and read them; scanned of the archive.org partial matches), resolving the record's 'p.29 or 30' to p.30.
